en.notification.settings.disable_warning.ap:
APIExpose has been disabled.

APIExpose automations will no longer process selections, media, scraping, ROM packs, themes, in-game events or WebSocket streams. Technical endpoints such as health/version may remain available.
en.notification.settings.disable_warning.lo:
Local Media Manager has been disabled.

Media projections, gamelist updates, image/logo/thumbnail allocation and live scraping that depends on local game cards will no longer run.
en.notification.settings.disable_warning.sc:
Auto Scraping Manager has been disabled.

Local then remote checks will no longer start automatically on game cards. Missing media will not be fetched during navigation.
en.notification.settings.disable_warning.th:
Themes Deployment has been disabled.

Deployable themes will no longer be scraped or installed automatically.

Themes Manager has been disabled.

.gameinfos exports, theme high-score data, CPO data and dependent integrations will no longer be produced.
en.notification.settings.disable_warning.cp:
CPO Control Panel Manager has been disabled.

Button colors, functions and controller types will no longer be exposed to themes, LED panels or related streams.
en.notification.settings.disable_warning.ma:
Marquee Manager has been disabled.

Marquee data intended for external clients and the marquee WebSocket stream will no longer be published.
en.notification.settings.disable_warning.ro:
Roms Manager has been disabled.

Romset filtering, pack installation, on-the-fly indexing and on-demand extraction will no longer work.
en.notification.settings.disable_warning.co:
Collections Pack Manager has been disabled.

Automatic installation of theme collection packs will no longer run at startup.
en.notification.settings.disable_warning.ga:
Game Events Manager has been disabled.

In-game listeners, console high-score capture, arcade events and game-end score export will no longer work.
en.notification.gamelist_impact.message:
{label} affects games.

You are currently on a game card. Return to the system screen before launching or testing this type of change.

While the current system stays in game-selected, EmulationStation can keep its previous view in memory: the current system may not refresh and changes may not be visible there. Other systems are still processed normally.
en.progress.reloadgames.title: EmulationStation refresh
en.progress.local_gamelist.title: Gamelist update

fr.notification.settings.disable_warning.ap:
APIExpose vient d'etre desactive.

Les automatismes APIExpose ne traiteront plus les selections, les medias, le scraping, les packs ROMs, les themes, les events ingame et les flux WebSocket. Les endpoints techniques comme health/version peuvent rester disponibles.
fr.notification.settings.disable_warning.lo:
Local Media Manager vient d'etre desactive.

Les projections media, les mises a jour gamelist, les allocations image/logo/vignette et le scraping live qui depend des fiches locales ne seront plus executes.
fr.notification.settings.disable_warning.sc:
Auto Scraping Manager vient d'etre desactive.

La verification locale puis distante ne se lancera plus automatiquement sur les fiches jeu. Les medias manquants ne seront donc plus recuperes en navigation.
fr.notification.settings.disable_warning.th:
Themes Deployment vient d'etre desactive.

Les themes deployables ne seront plus scrapes ni installes automatiquement.

Themes Manager vient d'etre desactive.

Les exports .gameinfos, les donnees high score theme, les donnees CPO et les integrations qui en dependent ne seront plus produits.
fr.notification.settings.disable_warning.cp:
CPO Control Panel Manager vient d'etre desactive.

Les couleurs de boutons, fonctions et types de controllers ne seront plus exposes aux themes, panels LED ou flux associes.
fr.notification.settings.disable_warning.ma:
Marquee Manager vient d'etre desactive.

Les donnees marquee prevues pour les clients externes et le flux WebSocket marquee ne seront plus publies.
fr.notification.settings.disable_warning.ro:
Roms Manager vient d'etre desactive.

Le filtrage romset, l'installation de packs, l'indexation on-the-fly et l'extraction a la demande ne fonctionneront plus.
fr.notification.settings.disable_warning.co:
Collections Pack Manager vient d'etre desactive.

L'installation automatique des packs collections de themes ne fonctionnera plus au demarrage.
fr.notification.settings.disable_warning.ga:
Game Events Manager vient d'etre desactive.

Les ecouteurs ingame, la capture high score console, les events arcade et l'export score au game-end ne fonctionneront plus.
fr.notification.gamelist_impact.message:
{label} impacte les jeux.

Vous etes actuellement dans une fiche jeu. Revenez sur l'ecran systeme avant de lancer ou tester ce type de modification.

Tant que le systeme courant reste en game-selected, EmulationStation peut garder son ancienne vue en memoire : le systeme courant peut ne pas etre rafraichi et les modifications peuvent ne pas y etre prises en compte. Les autres systemes restent traites normalement.

fr.progress.local_gamelist.title: Mise a jour gamelists
